verifyNotes: Confirm item count, time, fee, passing score, item types, domains and weights, and any recent exam-guide version against the official AWS exam page and exam guide PDF (aws.amazon.com/certification and docs.aws.amazon.com/aws-certification). Use current AWS service names (Amazon Bedrock and its features such as Knowledge Bases, Agents, Guardrails, model evaluation; Amazon SageMaker AI; Amazon Q). Never copy official sample questions.
name: AWS Certified AI Practitioner
audience: Business and technical people who use or evaluate AI/ML and generative AI on AWS (up to 6 months of AWS AI exposure)
format: 65 items (50 scored, 15 unscored) in 90 minutes; multiple choice, multiple response, ordering, matching and case study items; scaled score 100–1000, pass 700. This site practises multiple choice and multiple response only.
scenarios: Document search for a law firm

domains.name: Fundamentals of AI and ML
skills: Explain AI, ML, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, LLMs and key terms
Choose supervised, unsupervised or reinforcement learning; inference types (batch, real-time)
Identify when AI/ML is and is not the right fit; match use cases to AWS AI services (Comprehend, Rekognition, Transcribe, Translate, Textract, Lex, Polly, Personalize)
Describe the ML lifecycle and MLOps; SageMaker AI capabilities; model metrics (accuracy, F1, AUC) and business metrics

domains.name: Fundamentals of Generative AI
skills: Explain tokens, embeddings, vectors, transformers, foundation models, diffusion and multimodal models
Identify gen AI use cases, advantages and limitations (hallucination, nondeterminism, interpretability)
Explain the foundation-model lifecycle
Choose AWS gen AI infrastructure and services: Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker JumpStart, PartyRock, Amazon Q; cost trade-offs (on-demand vs provisioned throughput)

domains.name: Applications of Foundation Models
skills: Select a foundation model by cost, modality, latency, context size, customisation and multilingual needs
Set inference parameters (temperature, top-p, max tokens) and understand their effects
Design RAG with Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases and vector stores (OpenSearch, Aurora pgvector, etc.); agents with Amazon Bedrock Agents
Apply prompt engineering techniques and defend against prompt injection, jailbreaks and poisoning
Choose between prompting, RAG, fine-tuning, continued pre-training and distillation; data preparation
Evaluate foundation models: human evaluation, benchmark datasets, ROUGE/BLEU/BERTScore, Bedrock model evaluation

domains.name: Guidelines for Responsible AI
skills: Describe responsible AI features: bias, fairness, inclusivity, robustness, safety, veracity
Use AWS tools: Amazon Bedrock Guardrails, SageMaker Clarify, SageMaker Model Monitor, Amazon A2I, model cards
Explain transparency and explainability trade-offs; legal risks (IP, biased outputs, loss of trust)

domains.name: Security, Compliance, and Governance for AI Solutions
skills: Secure AI systems: IAM roles and policies, encryption, Amazon Macie, AWS PrivateLink, shared responsibility model
Data governance: lineage, cataloguing, retention, data residency, logging

Compliance and governance services: AWS Config, Amazon Inspector, AWS Audit Manager, AWS Artifact, AWS CloudTrail, Trusted Advisor; governance protocols and frameworks (e.g. Generative AI Security Scoping Matrix)
